content.short: 10X is a mobile app for leveraged trading on stocks, commodities, currencies and crypto.
content.description: 10X is a mobile trading app offering leveraged long and short positions of up to 50x on more than 150 markets, including stocks, commodities, currencies, ETFs and crypto, around the clock. It runs a mini app inside World App, listed in World's ecosystem directory.
content.meta: 10X is a mobile app for leveraged trading on 150+ markets, with a World App mini app.
